# Raster Forge

Pixel font by GGBotNet, released under CC0 1.0 (public domain); see `LICENSE-CC0.txt`.
Source: https://ggbot.itch.io/raster-forge-font (also mirrored on 1001fonts.com).

Used for the battery percentage and clock in the shelf footer. The design grid is 256 units on a
2048 upem, so it renders crisp only at multiples of 8 px; the theme uses 16 px.
